subject: english
stem: Jay reaches the signing line at 12:45. What is the result?
options: He can join because Hall C starts at 13:00.
He must buy a $3 Cookie first.
He is five minutes too late to join the line.

optionRationales.reason: He can join because Hall C starts at 13:00.：Hall C 與 signing line 不同。
He must buy a $3 Cookie first.：菜單不是參加條件。
He is five minutes too late to join the line.：附註說 12:40 關閉，12:45 晚五分鐘。
He is five minutes early.：時間方向相反。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 He is five minutes too late to join the line.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 He is five minutes too late to join the line. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
